question:
What are the values of x and y, respectively, from the following equations?

6x + 7y = 5xy

10y – 4x = 4xy
solution:
**GIVEN:**

6x + 7y = 5xy 

10y - 4x = 4xy 

**CALCULATION:**

Here, we have

6x + 7y = 5xy .................( 1) 

10y - 4x = 4xy .................( 2) 

On dividing eq(1) and eq(2) by xy , we get 

⇒ 6/y + 7/x = 5 ............(3)

⇒ 10/x - 4/y = 4 ..............(4)

Now, multiply eq(3) by 2 and eq(4) by 3 we get 

⇒ 12/y + 14/x = 10 ...............(5)

⇒ 30 /x - 12/ y = .12..............( 6)

Now, eq(5) + eq(6)

⇒ 14/x + 30/x = 22 

⇒ 44/x = 22 ⇔ x = 2 

Now, put the value of x = 2 in the eq(1), we get 

⇒ 6 × 2 + 7y = 5 × 2 y 

⇒ 12 = 3y 

⇒ y = 4 

**Hence, the values of x and y are 2 and 4 respectively .**
